correctness.rationale: Both exact labelled 12-vertex facet sets have face vector (12,57,148,165,66). Independently executed inspected verify.py: integral boundary d2 rank 46 with unimodular identity reduction; 102 integral 2-cycle coordinates, d3 rank 100 with unit diagonal and zero remainder, hence H2=Z^2. All binomial(12,4)=495 four-vertex supports enumerated for each triangulation; exactly 72 induced missing tetrahedral boundary spheres give primitive nonzero H2 classes. Computed up-to-sign integral multiplicities CP2#CP2=33,33,3,3 versus CP2#(-CP2)=33,33,6; both mod2=33,33,6. Lower supports cannot be nonzero simplicial 2-cycles. This proves finite exhaustive results only, not smooth minimal area.
